article.headline: Mark Freeman scores 23 as James Madison hands Coastal Carolina 12th straight loss, 74-73
article.description: — Mark Freeman scored 23 points to help James Madison hold off Coastal Carolina 74-73 on Saturday, extending the Chanticleers' losing streak to 12.
article.linkText: Mark Freeman scores 23 as James Madison hands Coastal Carolina 12th straight loss, 74-73

categories.description: James Madison Dukes @ Coastal Carolina Chanticleers

event.description: James Madison Dukes @ Coastal Carolina Chanticleers

keywords: James Madison Dukes @ Coastal Carolina Chanticleers
article.story: CONWAY, S.C. -- — Mark Freeman scored 23 points to help James Madison hold off Coastal Carolina 74-73 on Saturday, extending the Chanticleers' losing streak to 12. Freeman shot 6 for 16 (2 for 10 from 3-point range) and 9 of 10 from the free-throw line for the Dukes (17-10, 10-4 Sun Belt Conference). Xavier Brown added 18 points and six rebounds. Bryce Lindsay scored 16. The Chanticleers (8-19, 1-13) were led in scoring by Joshua Meo with 20 points. Rasheed Jones added 16 points and Jordan Battle scored 14. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
